main_text.p: Proinde explicare debent suorum instru-mentorum & fabricam sive naturam & usum.

p.i: Instrumenti vis tota consistit in actione, ait Logi-cus. Non igitur satis est, in artibus instrumento-rum naturam & architecturam explicare; oportet insuper eorundem usum adjicere. Ita Rhetorica non tantum instrumenta sua, tropos & figuras, explica-bit ratione architecturæ, sed etiam applicare docebit ratione usus.

main_text.head: PERORATIO TECHNOLOGIÆ.
main_text.p: CNncludam[?] nunc Technologiam meam, indica-tione usus, qui inde ad studiosos redire potest, precum item & typi adjectione.Peroratio Technolo-giæ.

Utilitas è technologia ad vos redibit, ô studiosi, permagna. Etenim discetis differentias & proprie-tates disciplinarum: videbitis, quâ methodo pro-Utilitas technolo-giæ.1. poni & disci debeant: videbitis, quot sint numero2. disciplinæ, & quænam ex iis vobis discenda sint: co-3. gnoscetis demq; ad quam quidq; disciplinam referre possitis, & quomodo unam eandemq; rem per varias disciplinas deducere liceat, id quod philosophi vocant4. sigillum technologiæ, sive encyclopædiæ. v.g.dicturus de pane, eum considerabit Metaphysicè, Physicè, OEconomicè, aliúsq; modis. Preces adjicito mecum, quicunque cupis hanc technologiam, vel quasdam saltem ejus partes percurrere: Domine Deus, pater cœlestis, ago tibi gratias, cùm pro aliis tuis summis & infinitis beneficiis, tùm vel maximè, quòd gratissimam de tuâ sapientiâ, bonitate, & potentiâ famam in artibus sparsisti. page.notes: The drop cap "CNncludam" is doubtful: the initial may be "Co" with a larger initial, so the word is marked [?]. The last word "pra-" is cut at the line end and the hyphen is kept as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout ("fuorum" is "suorum", "poteft" is "potest", "figillum" is "sigillum"). The marginal numbers 1.–4. are read from their position beside the lines.
